observations: PDF pages 1 and 3 both carry Image 276, CC8/8/5, the Johne Glasgw download title and the same generation timestamp. Page 2 carries Image 277.
Page 1 shows the complete leaf numbered 276. Page 3 shows an irregular-edged horizontal strip marked 396A beside an older struck-through number.
No repeated underlying John lines establish a raised/lowered-flap pair, and the exact physical attachment cannot be demonstrated from the supplied photographs.
The rubric identifies the confirmation of Andro Hutchesoun: identification of the separate testament is strong, but exact surname spelling remains provisional.
The fresh partial reading contains repeated Andro Huchesoun, secure bairnis, and provisional Johne [huchesoun?]. The incomplete grammar does not securely assign their kinship or legal roles.
interpretation: The heading identifies the confirmation of Andro Huchesoun's testament. The readable body approves a testament or inventory, commits administration of the estate, and concerns an executor's office and caution (security). It has not been established as an additional inventory or eik for John Glasgow.
family_lead: The supplied human reading hochaine, possibly a phonetic Hutchin form, makes the Hutcheson fragment relevant to Margaret and the family network. Neither surname normalization nor a specific relationship to Andro is established.
next_steps: Ask NRS or ScotlandsPeople to explain the mapping between strip 396A and CC8/8/5 Image 276, and identify the strip's own testament reference, indexed person and date.
Resolve the complete Johne/Andro/bairnis clause before assigning children, parentage or executor roles. Retain unread words rather than supplying an expected formula.

Compare the securely identified people, places, property and associates with John and Margaret. Test the proposed Hochaine/Hutchin connection without treating surname resemblance or PDF inclusion as proof.

reading_findings.name: Andro Huchesoun
reading_findings.finding: Named in the heading and repeatedly in the body. Exact individual-letter spelling remains qualified. Umquhile Andro identifies a deceased Andro, but the incomplete clause does not distinguish every occurrence or establish a younger namesake.

reading_findings.name: Johne [huchesoun?]
reading_findings.finding: A provisional reading in body line 4, not a secure identification and not a reading of Johne Glasgow. His legal and family roles remain unresolved.

reading_findings.name: Bairnis (children)
reading_findings.finding: The word is securely read in line 5. Missing surrounding words prevent assigning named children to a particular father or identifying their executor or representative roles.

reading_findings.name: John Glasgow and Margaret
reading_findings.finding: No Glasgow surname has been securely read in the strip. The fragment does not yet establish a relationship to John or Margaret; this is not evidence that no relationship existed.

research_question: Why is strip 396A included with John Glasgow's CC8/8/5 Image 276, and which testament entry does the strip belong to?
attachment_limit: The PDF associates the supplementary image with John's selected record. The full register pages are numbered 276-277; the irregular strip is marked 396A beside an older struck-through number, provisionally 199. The photographs do not establish its original physical placement, a textual continuation from John, a family connection, or a scanning/cataloguing error.
